knowledge.q: Will my GTA Online character transfer to GTA 6?
knowledge.text: Nothing has been announced: no character, no money, no assets, no rank. The only precedent is within GTA V: the Enhanced version on PC, in March 2025, let you carry over your progress. Take-Two says it will keep today’s GTA Online going after GTA VI’s release.
knowledge.status: Answer from the “GTA Online” FAQ, sources at the bottom of the page

knowledge.q: Will today’s GTA Online keep going?
knowledge.text: Yes, according to Take-Two: on September 17, 2026, the publisher said again that it would support GTA Online “after GTA 6’s release and beyond”. In August, Strauss Zelnick talked about a steady pace of updates; The Kortz Center Heist, released on July 14, 2026, is one of the latest.

knowledge.q: Do you need PlayStation Plus or Game Pass to play GTA 6?
knowledge.text: Nothing suggests so: GTA VI is announced as a single-player game, and its PlayStation page says it can be played offline. No subscription is mentioned to play it.
